behavioral_effects: e2e job records the backend PID and terminates the process tree in an always-run step before job cleanup
follow_up: Watch this push: the e2e job should complete green end to end
reason: The first green e2e run (34 passed) still failed the job: setup-uv's post step runs uv cache prune, the nohup'd uv run backend process was still holding the cache, and the prune hung for five minutes before exiting 2. After this change the job records the backend's PID and an always-run step terminates it before the post steps.
summary: Stop the backgrounded backend at the end of the CI e2e job so setup-uv's cache prune cannot hang on it
